name: mcp-execution-handoff
description: Security-oriented execution handoff primitives for MCP workflows that require explicit human intervention.

scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.accept:webrtc:lan: swift build -c release --package-path experiments/thin-takeover-runtime --product takeover-webrtc-host && tsx experiments/thin-takeover-runtime/scripts/webrtc-lan-acceptance.mts
scripts.accept:webrtc:public-relay: swift build -c release --package-path experiments/thin-takeover-runtime --product takeover-webrtc-host && HANDOFF_ACCEPT_MODE=public-relay tsx experiments/thin-takeover-runtime/scripts/webrtc-lan-acceptance.mts
scripts.accept:window:macos-native-text: swift build -c release --package-path experiments/thin-takeover-runtime --product takeover-webrtc-host && swift build -c release --package-path experiments/thin-takeover-runtime --product takeover-macos-text-input-fixture && tsx experiments/thin-takeover-runtime/scripts/macos-native-window-text-acceptance.mts
scripts.accept:window:macos-secure-ui: swift build -c release --package-path experiments/thin-takeover-runtime --product takeover-webrtc-host && tsx experiments/thin-takeover-runtime/scripts/macos-secure-ui-window-acceptance.mts
scripts.accept:window:macos-lineage: swift build -c release --package-path experiments/thin-takeover-runtime --product takeover-webrtc-host && tsx experiments/thin-takeover-runtime/scripts/macos-window-lineage-acceptance.mts
